create_Stopwatch: create a Stopwatch instance to track elapsed time between operations using named keys
call_Stopwatch_time: call the time method on a Stopwatch with a key to record elapsed milliseconds since last call
call_Stopwatch_summary: call the summary method on a Stopwatch to print per-key mean time and percentage breakdown then reset
call_Stopwatch_reset: call the reset method on a Stopwatch to clear all recorded times and restart the clock
call_millis_interval: call millis_interval with two datetime instances to compute the elapsed time in milliseconds
